lore: Once a noble warrior of the Legion, Accursed was transformed by dark magic into a demonic knight who absorbs incoming damage to heal himself and allies.
abilitiesJson: [{"name": "Cauterize", "description": "Sacrifices health to heal an ally or damage an enemy."}, {"name": "Volatile Shield", "description": "Shields an ally, removing debuffs and exploding when destroyed."}, {"name": "Sear", "description": "Attacks slow enemies and grant movement/attack speed to allies."}, {"name": "Flame Consumer", "description": "Passively converts incoming damage into health."}]

lore: A grotesque nightmare of flesh and iron hook, Devourer pulls unwary targets from afar into his toxic embrace.
abilitiesJson: [{"name": "Guttling Hook", "description": "Launches a hooked chain that drags the first target hit to Devourer."}, {"name": "Decay", "description": "Emits a poisonous cloud that damages nearby enemies and slows them."}, {"name": "Cadaver Armor", "description": "Grants magic resistance and bonus strength for nearby kills."}, {"name": "Devour", "description": "Disables an enemy hero and devours their flesh over time."}]

lore: Master of destructive fire magic, Pyromancer incinerates enemy armies with cataclysmic elemental bursts.
abilitiesJson: [{"name": "Phoenix Wave", "description": "Launches a wave of fire damaging all enemies in its path."}, {"name": "Dragon Strike", "description": "Stuns enemies in a target area after a brief delay."}, {"name": "Fervor", "description": "Spells grant stacking attack speed and movement speed."}, {"name": "Blazing Strike", "description": "Deals massive single-target magic damage."}]

lore: Armed with a holy pistol and ancient incantations, Witch Slayer purges dark sorcery and annihilates enemies.
abilitiesJson: [{"name": "Graveyard", "description": "Impales a line of enemies, stunning and dealing damage."}, {"name": "Miniaturize", "description": "Transforms an enemy into a harmless critter."}, {"name": "Power Drain", "description": "Drains mana from an enemy over time."}, {"name": "Silver Bullet", "description": "Fires a holy bullet dealing massive magic damage."}]

lore: A legendary swordmaster whose blade moves faster than the eye can follow, slicing through armor effortlessly.
abilitiesJson: [{"name": "Blade Frenzy", "description": "Spins with his sword, dealing damage and becoming immune to magic."}, {"name": "Counter Attack", "description": "Passively chance to counterattack when struck."}, {"name": "Way of the Sword", "description": "Passively grants critical strike chance."}, {"name": "Swift Slashes", "description": "Omnislash jumping between nearby enemy targets dealing heavy damage."}]
